Parallel Agents: Multiple Kiros Working at Once

Why run one agent when you can run three?
Parallel agents let multiple Kiro agents work concurrently.
They learn and improve across sessions, not just within one.
Bigger tasks move faster when they're split across agents.

Episode 73 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
